faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Assistant position at NIT Jamshedpur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Project Assistant post is 15 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Life Science or a related field with a minimum of 55% marks is required. A Master's degree with molecular biology research experience is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be selected for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for the Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply by sending their applications via email to the specified address.

faq.question: Q7. Are candidates with NET-JRF qualifications encouraged to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who have qualified for National Eligibility Tests such as CSIR/UGC/DBT/ICMR/GATE NET-JRF are encouraged to apply.

faq.question: Q8. What documents need to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: You need to attach a single PDF containing the filled Application Form, CV, Motivation Letter, and self-attested copies of all mark sheets and certificates from Xth class onwards, along with proof of work experience if any.

faq.question: Q9. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The age limit is as per the norms of the Govt. of India/DST for project assistant recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article for your convenience.
